svg.aria-label: You don’t have to trust us — verify
svg.title: You don’t have to trust us — verify
svg.text: You don’t have to trust us — verify
The claims are properties you can check, not promises. Every one is gated — in the runtime, on the bench, in CI — and the checks run in the open.
every grounded answer is verified before release
every figure is value-matched to tool output
honesty under adversarial questioning — two red lines
does the model reason, or pattern-match?
every claim in the docs must resolve against the code
architectural debt is ratcheted, never grows
measured, not asserted — read them, run them
